description: Public grants and subsidies (BDNS) awarded to the company, in integer cents of the awarded amount (never payments). Up to 200 attested rows. May answer 503 `projection_unavailable` when the integrations projection is offline: that is not evidence of "no grants".

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

name: borme_get_company_grants
